summary: Feature 24 Learning Hub cinematic rebuild — backend 8/8 pytest pass, frontend main flows verified (momentum strip, cinema hero, 4 rails with UNIQUE cover images 48/48 200s, journey cover banners, enrollment CTA flip). One critical UI bug found: mark-complete does NOT trigger celebration overlay (setCelebration is never called with a payload).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the Complete button in the Lesson Playback modal only emits telemetry (event_type='complete') and updates lessonPlayer positionSeconds — it NEVER calls setCelebration(...). The <CelebrationOverlay payload={celebration}/> is wired at line 1911 but `celebration` state (line 218) is only reset (to null) via onNext/onClose. Result: the celebration overlay (data-testid=ai-learning-hub-celebration-overlay), title, next-lesson CTA and 'Keep going' close are dead code — they never render on Mark complete. Verified in browser: after clicking [data-testid=ai-learning-hub-lesson-player-complete-button], overlay=None, title=None, next=None, close=None.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking [data-testid='ai-learning-hub-enroll-<course_id>'], the corresponding [data-testid='ai-learning-hub-enrolled-<course_id>'] Resume button was not immediately found in a subsequent DOM query. However, ACTIVE course count did increase 4 -> 5 in the KPI strip on reload, indicating the enrollment persisted server-side. The card likely re-renders under a different key or moves into 'Continue learning' rail. Recommend main-agent verify optimistic UI update state.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix markComplete in /app/frontend/src/components/learning-hub/EnterpriseLearningHubScreen.tsx line 701 to call setCelebration({courseId, lessonId, nextLesson, ...}) after successful telemetry. The CelebrationOverlay JSX (line 1911) and setCelebration setter (line 218) exist but are never populated. Without this, the celebration overlay + next-lesson autoplay CTA + confetti described in the review request are completely unreachable to users.
OPTIONAL: Investigate the two low-severity console errors during hub load (one 401 and one 403 on non-blocking endpoints) — they do not affect functionality but pollute the console.

markComplete swallows errors from setError in emitLessonTelemetry but still returns ws=null; the celebration is expected to fire only on ws!=null, so once fixed, guard with `if (ws) setCelebration(...)`.

cinema-hero-enroll and cinema-hero-resume are mutually exclusive by design (only one is shown depending on enrollment state) — this is correct but not clearly documented in the spec; the test-fixture must select the right assertion.

rca_of_the_issue: CelebrationOverlay never fires: The markComplete handler (line 701) emits lesson-complete telemetry via emitLessonTelemetry and updates lessonPlayer.positionSeconds, but it never invokes setCelebration({...}) with the finished lesson + next-lesson metadata. The CelebrationOverlay component is rendered conditionally on `celebration` state which stays null forever, so the overlay markup (data-testid=ai-learning-hub-celebration-overlay/-title/-next/-close) is unreachable. Fix: after `const ws = await emitLessonTelemetry(...)` succeeds, compute nextLesson (find next lesson in course.video_lessons after current lessonId) and call setCelebration({ courseId: lessonPlayer.courseId, lessonId: lessonPlayer.lessonId, title: lessonPlayer.title, nextLesson }). Then the onNext handler (already wired at line 1912) will call openCourseVideo(courseId, nextLesson) correctly.
